nextStoryContext: All 4 stories in this PRD (US-001..US-004) now have passes:true. Applied the matching edit to templates/scripts/cam/journal.md's guideline bullet, using colon/period instead of em-dash since that file is persisted human-readable markdown (agent instruction files are exempt and used '--' freely). Did NOT touch the live scripts/cam/journal.md on this branch -- confirmed via git diff against merge-base with origin/main, per an explicit AC oracle guarding that path (it is mutated on main by commit-tree during live cycles per the cam-finalize-clobbers-stale-branch-backlog pattern). Regenerated src/vendor/_generated.ts via bun run embed-vendor after the templates/ edits; embed-vendor:check is clean. Full quality spine (bun run check:all: test/embed-vendor/lint/file-size/debt-markers/version-skips/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity) is green. Next agent invocation should find prd.json fully passing and exit PRD_COMPLETE; if a new story is added later, no further journal-archive-rule doc-sync work remains for this epic.
